title: AI-Native Adaptive Learning Engine
description: Designed an adaptive exam-preparation engine using syllabus/PYQ analysis and learner state from mock performance, doubts and interaction history. Built a multi-agent orchestrator for exam analysis, strategy generation/refinement, mock generation and context-aware QA. Added targeted RAG for study content and learning memory, PostgreSQL for learner state, and MCP-based controlled access. Feedback from mocks and recurring misconceptions reprioritizes the learner’s study strategy.

title: RAGify India — Legal AI Research System
description: Developed a RAG-based legal question-answering system using Mistral-7B, LLaMA, LangChain, FAISS and semantic search across 50+ Indian legal acts. Built document preprocessing, chunking, embedding generation and FAISS indexing. Constructed a benchmark dataset of 500+ legal queries for retrieval benchmarking, model evaluation and generation quality analysis.

title: AI Trip Planner
description: Developed a multi-agent AI trip-planning system with Research, Optimization and Recommendation agents. Designed a weighted optimization algorithm combining cost, travel time, ratings and user preferences to generate personalized, constraint-aware itineraries. Added context-aware personalization using travel season, regional preferences and destination metadata.
